decisions.label: SUPPORTED
decisions.rationale: The direct ablation comparison shows Method M-dynamic scoring higher with FILTER/NN than without on every reported metric; describing these techniques as contributing is calibrated to that evidence, despite absent significance tests.

decisions.label: UNDERSTATED
decisions.rationale: The four listed improvements are real, but KA also improved from 73.92 to 74.27. Thus Method M-dynamic improved COMET on all five low-resource pairs, making “four of five” understated.

decisions.label: SUPPORTED
decisions.rationale: The with-versus-without ablation reports higher scores with FILTER/NN. The cautious wording “indicating” reasonably attributes a contribution to the techniques, although no significance tests were reported.

decisions.label: UNSUPPORTED
decisions.rationale: T1 provides numerical differences but no stated criterion or source interpretation establishing that they are small. The qualitative magnitude claim therefore lacks support rather than being demonstrably contradicted.

decisions.label: UNSUPPORTED
decisions.rationale: KA COMET increased from 73.92 under supervised fine-tuning to 74.27 for Method M-dynamic. The stated values directly contradict the claim that performance decreased.
